purpose: Teach: 天神/芦屋/藤岡/萩原/フィジカル/エキサイトブログ/ハンナ/ケインズ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、福岡の天神でショッピングされてきたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer went shopping in Tenjin, Fukuoka, didn't they?
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Sharing something noticed. Warm curiosity without pressure. Gentle upward lift at the end—an invitation to confirm, not demand.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、芦屋のご出身だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer is from Ashiya originally, aren't they?
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the voice. Like turning over a small, delicate fact. Pause before the question mark—letting it settle. Almost conversational musing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、映画監督の藤岡弘、を尊敬されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer really admires film director Hiroshi Fujioka, don't they?
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 'admires'—respectful nod to that kind of devotion. Steady, understated. The tone of someone sharing something meaningful they've learned.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、漫画家萩原一至先生のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer is a fan of manga artist Kazushi Hagiwara, right?
lines.style: Light, almost playful note—the delight of discovering a shared passion. Easy, conversational rhythm. Slight warmth in the delivery, like 'isn't that nice?'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジムでフィジカル鍛えてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer works out at the gym, training up their strength, aren't they?
lines.style: Gentle observation with quiet respect. No judgment—just noting something disciplined and real. Slight nod in the voice. Even pacing, grounded.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エキサイトブログをご自身で更新されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer keeps their own Excite blog updated, don't they?
lines.style: Soft admiration—the kind reserved for small, deliberate habits. Thoughtful pause. Recognition of the effort it takes to maintain something personal.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ピアニストのハンナのリサイタルに行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer went to pianist Hanna's recital, didn't they?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity. The note of someone who appreciates that they'd make the time for live music. Warm, almost tender delivery. Slight dreamy quality.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、経済学者ケインズの著作を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer has been reading economist Keynes's work, haven't they?
lines.style: Quiet respect woven through. Slow, thoughtful delivery—like acknowledging something intellectually serious. Fade gently at the end, almost reflective.
